from tslearn.metrics.softdtw_variants import SoftDTW, SquaredEuclidean

# Reshape 1-D series to (n_timestamps, n_features) as required by SquaredEuclidean
X_ts = s1.reshape(-1, 1)
Y_ts = s2.reshape(-1, 1)

# Construct the low-level SquaredEuclidean helper
sq_euc = SquaredEuclidean(X_ts, Y_ts)

# Construct the low-level SoftDTW helper using the SquaredEuclidean object
soft_dtw_obj = SoftDTW(D=sq_euc, gamma=1.0)

# Compute the Soft-DTW discrepancy
sdtw_score = soft_dtw_obj.compute()

# Verify the result and the documented side-effects
assert isinstance(sdtw_score, float), "Score must be a float"
assert soft_dtw_obj.computed is True, "compute() must set self.computed to True"
assert hasattr(soft_dtw_obj, "R_"), "compute() must populate self.R_"

print(f"__CHECK__ compute {sdtw_score:.4f}")
